work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent numbered CLX has its own synopsis and Clement XII protocol, preamble, continuous sections 1–4, and complete original/editorial dating 12268–12271. Its substantive remission of occupied ecclesiastical property and power of disposal are fully printed at 12193–12239; the reference to Alexander VII and other earlier concessions is the current act's historical recital, not a substitute for its body. The selected ranges exclude foreign note 12071, which matches the preceding act's pontificate-year marker 12026, while retaining this act's synopsis note 12073–12074 and correction note 12142. The abbreviation at 12267 is the conventional exemplars/transumpts formula, with its explicit continuation-reference note 12312; the separate date-day and pontificate-year notes 12314 and 12316 match markers 12269–12270 and are retained in a disjoint range. These three notes fall after the next CLXI heading but do not belong to that act. The interleaved marginal synopsis also abbreviates its list with literal eie at 12186; the apparent eie- at 12093 continues clor at 12097 within elector and is not a body omission. Formula abbreviations and date corrections remain literal and unexpanded; no substantive editorial body replacement was found. Previous act publication/signature ends 12052; next CLXI begins 12274. Dates remain unresolved, without reconciling the printed year correction.
